pages.title: Ashmont
pages.extract: There is more than one place called Ashmont:

pages.title: Boring
pages.description: census-designated places in Clackamas County, Oregon
pages.extract: Boring, an unincorporated community of 8,000 people in the Willamette Valley, Oregon, is twinned with Dull, Scotland and Bland Shire, New South Wales. The Boring official slogan is "The most exciting place to live."

pages.title: Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park
pages.description: national park of Brazil located in the Chapada dos Veadeiros, an ancient plateau with an estimated age of 1.8 billion years
pages.extract: The Chapada dos Veadeiros is a natural area in the state of Goias, Brazil. It is also the name of a National Park within that area, listed as a World Natural Heritage Site by UNESCO for being an outstanding preservation area of the Cerrado – one of the world's oldest and most diverse tropical ecosystems.

pages.title: Falaise
pages.extract: Falaise is a town (population 9,000) on the Ante River in the French department of Calvados, south of the regional centre Caen. It is famous as the birthplace of William the Conqueror and as the scene of remarkably fierce fighting in August 1944 during the Battle of Normandy, after the D-Day landings on the coast north of Caen.

pages.title: Florida
pages.description: state of the United States of America

pages.title: Luganville
pages.extract:
Luganville, also known by the names Santo and Kanal is the largest town on Espiritu Santo, and with about 16,000 inhabitants second largest in Vanuatu. The main centre of Vanuatu's biggest island, it has many Chinese stores as well as a few restaurants. Luganville is also one of the country's most important freight ports and was the site of a US military base during the Second World War.
The temperature hovers between 20 and 30 °C (68 and 86 °F) around the year, usually with plenty of rain (average yearly precipitation is about 3,000 mm (120 in)). The first months of the year are the rainiest ones, and it is relatively drier between July and September.

pages.title: Maha Sarakham
pages.description: town in Maha Sarakham province, Thailand
pages.extract: Maha Sarakham (Thai: มหาสารคาม, also spelt Mahasarakham) is a city and province in Isaan.

pages.title: Menominee
pages.description: city in and county seat of Menomiee County, Michigan, United States
pages.extract: Menominee is a city in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. It is across the Menominee River from Marinette, Wisconsin.

pages.title: Potomac
pages.description: census-designated place in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States, suburb of Washington, DC

pages.title: Sanmenxia
pages.extract: Sanmenxia (三门峡; Sānménxiá) is a city in western Henan with 2.2 million inhabitants. Situated along the upper reaches of the Yellow River, Sanmenxia is known for its breathtaking natural scenery and historical significance. The city is home to the impressive Sanmenxia Dam, a major engineering landmark, and boasts a rich cultural heritage with ancient sites and scenic spots, making it a popular destination for both history enthusiasts and nature lovers.

pages.title: Shizuishan
pages.extract: Shizuishan (石嘴山) is a city in Ningxia Autonomous Region.

pages.title: Te Anau
pages.extract: Te Anau is a small town on the shore of Lake Te Anau, in the Southland region of the South Island.  It is the gateway to Fiordland National Park and Milford Road.

pages.title: Bhimavaram
pages.description: Town in West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, India
pages.extract: Bhimavaram is a small colourful city in central Andhra Pradesh, with a population of about 1.5 lakh or 150 thousand.

pages.title: Cincinnati/Over-the-Rhine
pages.extract: Over-the-Rhine (OTR) is Cincinnati's largest historic district. It is the location of Music Hall, home of the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra and Cincinnati Opera; Findlay Market, Ohio's oldest public market in continuous operation; the Main Street Entertainment District; and much of Cincinnati's creative arts. Also of note is the Gateway Quarter a rebranded part of the neighborhood which has some of the city's hottest and hippest bars and dining spots between Central Parkway and 14th Street on Vine.

pages.title: Bigfork
pages.description: census designated place in Flathead County, Montana, United States
pages.extract: Bigfork is a small town on northeast shore of Flathead Lake in Northwestern Montana. About 5,100 people lived there in 2020.

pages.title: Parc de la Serralada Litoral
pages.extract: Parc de la Serralada Litoral is in Barcelona province of Catalonia in Spain. The park is a protected area, preserving its unique ecosystems, flora, and fauna. It is a haven for hikers, nature enthusiasts, and those seeking to explore the cultural and natural heritage of Catalonia's coastal mountains.

pages.title: Bururi
pages.extract: Bururi is a town in the southern region of Burundi and the capital of Bururi Province. It is known for its scenic highlands, rich biodiversity, and cultural heritage.

pages.title: Skoura
pages.extract: Skoura (Berber: ⵙⴽⵓⵔⴰ, Arabic: سكورة) is a town in Ouarzazate Province, Drâa-Tafilalet, Saharan Morocco. It consists of a modern town as well as a historical oasis and palmeraie with traditional rammed-earth architecture.

pages.title: Diving the Cape Peninsula and False Bay/Bill Liltved's Reef
Kyparissia
pages.extract: Kyparissia is a coastal town in western Messenia, overlooking the Ionian Sea. Kyparissia is a relaxed and relatively untouristed destination, making it a good base for exploring western Messenia. Built on the slopes below a medieval castle, it is divided into two distinct parts: the atmospheric Upper Town (Ano Poli), with narrow lanes and traditional stone houses, and the modern Lower Town along the coast, centred around the harbour and beaches.
